objectives.description: Snapshot self-exclusion sessionId and confirm transcript exists
Time jq-only is_error pass over nvim slice

approaches_tried.approach: bare jq -c '.. | objects | select(has("is_error"))' per-file without -s slurp
approaches_tried.reason: jq applies filter once per top-level JSON value (once per jsonl line) rather than once for the whole file, producing hundreds of tiny arrays instead of one file-level count; fixed by adding -s to slurp first

approaches_tried.approach: bare jq whole-stream read of history.jsonl
approaches_tried.reason: jq aborts (exit 5) at the first embedded-raw-newline parse error rather than skipping it, recovering only 23321 of ~23775 records; replaced with Python json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode skip-and-continue loop, which recovered 23775 records with only 1 failure
